bio.text: Scott Flippo is a Republican member of the Arkansas Senate for District 23.
The legislature's member page lists Senate service beginning in 2015 and gives Flippo's occupation as assisted living owner.

According to the Senate biography, Flippo was elected in 2014 and took the oath of office at the start of the 2015 regular session; Flippo chairs the Senate State Agencies and Governmental Affairs Committee and has served as Senate Majority Whip and Majority Leader.

Flippo is a native of Mountain Home, graduated from Mountain Home High School, holds a business administration degree from the University of Arkansas, and owns Carefree Living, an assisted living center, according to the biography.
